text: Tch, what a pain in the neck! Given her position,\nChristmas trends should be something she pays\nattention to all the time.
Hm, I guess I'll have to eavesdrop if I want to\nsecretly find out what the children like. I'll\nhide somewhere around here and spy on them...Hm?
Hey, pleasure seeker...Hey, lazy bum...\nRemember your place...
It seems that the adventurers did a good job…
